mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average, the discount rate for future cash flows declines, lowering the present value of expected dividends and thereby pushing S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year average for at least 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the low-rate period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate signals accelerating inflation, which typically precedes a rate hike cycle and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above a 12-month moving average while UNRATE falls below a 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns remain positive despite inflation indicators meeting or exceeding the trigger condition (p > 0.05 two-tailed test).

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) in the current quarter suggests stronger labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate optimism and drive S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Payroll employment does not translate into higher SPX 5-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months indicates weakening demand for manufactured goods, which is associated with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below trend (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in the RSAFS (real private investment) followed by a sustained rise in the GDP deflator (implied by CPIAUCSL) suggests a shift from capital to asset investment, reducing future earnings growth and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls 3% while CPIAUCSL rises 2% in the same quarter
regime_hint: Transition from investment to asset allocation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (Rank IC > -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it often coincides with corporate hiring acceleration that boosts earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE < 4% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of declining consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) suggests deflationary pressure, which typically reduces discount rates and supports higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are flat or negative during deflationary episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real private investment (RSAFS) both show simultaneous declines for two consecutive quarters, it signals a dual supply-side contraction that tends to depress corporate earnings growth and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 2 consecutive quarters AND RSAFS falls for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not statistically different from zero despite the trigger (p > 0.05).
